Heroes of Might and Magic II.name: Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars
Heroes of Might and Magic II.summary:
Heroes of Might and Magic II is a Game Boy Color game created using content from Heroes of Might and Magic I, II, and III.

Most of the game's graphics are converted from Heroes of Might and Magic III, while gameplay is a mix of the three games. The campaign centers around a dragon slayer quest.

Within the game, there are four playable factions: Castle, Rampart, Fortress and Stronghold. There are a total of 40 heroes and 28 faction based creatures and 4 neutral creatures.

Toobin'.name: Toobin'
Toobin'.summary: Toobin' involves Biff and Jet racing their way down the rapids of a river, riding on tires. You rotate your tyre left or right, and drift as the current sends you, making sure to avoid the banks of the river, and the dividing lines in the middle. Hazards include crocodiles, stray logs and branches, and fishermen - you are armed with a limited supply of tin cans to take care of these. There are gates to slide through on the way down - these give you a points bonus. Each level has a strict time limit to adhere to, although there's a kickin' party at the end if you succeed.
